_comment: Project-AMBIGUOUS golden set. Every question is specific enough to have exactly one correct answering document, but deliberately NEVER names its project (no alias from PROJECT_ALIASES or TECH_ALIASES appears). This is the case `_diversify` mishandles: with no project detected, retrieval treats the query as a survey and caps every project to RETRIEVAL_DIVERSITY_MAX_PER_PROJECT chunks, so the owning project cannot supply enough context to answer. A companion test asserts detect_projects() returns an empty set for each question here — if that ever fails, the case has stopped testing what it was written to test.

queries.question: How many shapes does the home page star field cycle through, and how long is each one held before it changes?
expected_points: Four shapes: the formed name, a galaxy variant, a wordmark, a sparse field

queries.question: Why is the device pixel ratio capped at 1.5 instead of the value the browser reports?
expected_points: At DPR 2 the internal buffer is 4x the CSS-pixel area
The bloom mipmap chain scales with pixel count

queries.question: What happens to the fixed bottom-corner controls when the footer scrolls into view?
expected_points: They lift by the footer's intrusion into the viewport
Hiding them was rejected because it removes the only audio control

queries.question: How is the browser's limit on live WebGL contexts respected when two rendering engines are on screen together?
expected_points: The context-budget invariant across the two-engine bridge

queries.question: What caused players to lose their saved progress in May 2026, and how was it prevented afterwards?
expected_points: The May 2026 save wipe and its cause

queries.question: What went wrong when cached values were serialized and dates came back as something other than dates?
Why did text extracted from documents contain characters that were not visible on the page?
Why did a waiter thread break long jobs, and what replaced it?
expected_points: The waiter thread that killed long books

queries.question: How are separate customers kept isolated when they all share one database schema?
How is request throttling implemented without an in-memory key-value store?
What was the tempo-unit confusion that caused the first systemic bug in the music code?
How does a single repeating pattern get arranged into the sections of a whole song?
